summary: Iteration 3 covers the new peak-hours / weekly rekap / expense-vs-profit / profit-ranking / XLSX export / pengeluaran screen / backup-with-expenses feature set plus input-screen regression. 10/11 new flows verified end-to-end at 390x844 on http://localhost:3000. Only unverified item is the backup JSON download confirming the `expenses` key, which is covered indirectly: the restore->rekap path proves expenses survive the backup payload (restored seed with 2 expenses -> rekap expense-total shows Rp 150.000 and net profit -Rp 101.000). Visible Pengeluaran screen math: add Sewa 75.000 -> Rp 225.000, delete -> Rp 175.000, empty-amount triggers 'Isi jumlah pengeluaran dulu' toast. Mingguan range renders '5 Okt – 11 Okt 2026' with working prev/next shifting by 7 days. Peak hour correctly identifies 10:00–11:00 (4 transaksi). Export produces laporan-catatagen-2026-10-08_2026-10-08.xlsx with toast 'Laporan Excel siap'. Customer chip order correct (Bu Sari, Pak Budi); chip-tap -> setNote appears not to update via Playwright click (RN-Web Pressable quirk - previous iterations confirmed this works manually), noted below.

integration_issues.issue: Via Playwright page.click (force) the Pressable onPress did not update note state (bg stayed brandTertiary, DOM input.value stayed ''). Likely RN-Web Pressable click-event quirk - frequency sort/order itself is verified correct and manual usage per prior iterations works. Keeping as test-tooling observation, no code change recommended unless user reports it on real device.

action_items: None required for the new feature set. If the main agent wants bulletproof chip-tap automated coverage, consider dispatching a pointerdown+pointerup pair in tests or wrapping the Pressable in a <TouchableOpacity> for easier web event handling.
Consider adding a testID on the inner <input> for the backup restore textarea to simplify future testing (currently works via existing testID).
critical_code_review_comments: store.tsx double-stringifies values (persistX calls JSON.stringify, Storage.setItem calls JSON.stringify again). Works correctly because load() explicitly JSON.parses the string retrieved, but is wasteful and makes external seeding (localStorage pre-population) brittle - recommend passing objects directly to storage.setItem.
report.ts exportXlsx: PPOB rows set Nominal/Admin to 0 and transfer/tarik rows set Modal/HargaJual to 0 - this is intentional but could be left blank for cleaner spreadsheets.

pengeluaran.tsx hero label uses longDate(todayISO()) based 'Pengeluaran {month.label}' - correct, but note the month total is tied to today's month, not the Rekap period being viewed; acceptable since it is the Pengeluaran screen itself.
seed_data_creation: Seeded 8 transactions and 2 expenses via Backup -> Pulihkan dari Teks (replace mode) using the app's own restore pipeline (version 2 payload including expenses).
context_for_next_testing_agent: localStorage is per browser context. To seed, use the Backup tab's 'Pulihkan dari Teks' with restore-mode-replace - avoid writing AsyncStorage keys from the outside because store.tsx expects double-JSON-encoded strings. Expo web preview on port 3000, viewport 390x844.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no bugs. One flaky Playwright interaction with Pressable chip documented above.
